answer: Sybil defence works by making each identity carry a non-transferable cost tied to real work. Every agent stakes a bond locked for a season; forging a thousand keys means a thousand idle stakes earning nothing, so each fake identity is a lagoon of sunk capital, not a free ripple in the vote count. Reputation also flows only through attested pairwise history, so fresh keys arrive with no garden of earned trust and stay near zero weight until real peers vouch. The attacker pays the full stake on every fake key plus the time to fake credibility; an honest operator pays once and keeps working.
